CT-A.statement: All connections of the pool are in use (the pool is full); then a caller requests a connection; that caller waits instead of failing.
CT-A.fragment: When the connection pool is full, support for connection waiting

CT-E.statement: A caller puts a connection back into the pool; afterwards Release is called; Release closes that returned connection.
CT-E.fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool

CT-F.statement: An idle connection stays in the pool longer than the maximum idle time; afterwards a caller requests a connection; the pool closes and discards that expired connection instead of handing it out.
CT-F.fragment: the timeout connection will be closed and discarded
